caption: The drawing shows a tall wooden grandfather clock placed centrally on a plain, light beige background. The clock is rendered in brown tones with visible wood grain texture on its vertical body. The clock face is circular, silver or gray in color, and detailed with black Roman numerals and clock hands. Above the clock face is an arched hood with three small finials on top—one at the center and two at the sides. Beneath the clock face, the body of the clock cabinet is rectangular and narrow, with a door featuring a small round glass window and a brass-colored handle. The base of the clock is wider and has a panel design, resting on short, curved feet. The overall composition is vertically oriented, and the objects are centrally aligned with ample negative space on all sides.
title: Tall Clock
